question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The movie's plot was __predictable__, with clichéd twists and turns.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"predictable"** means something that can be anticipated or expected beforehand; it refers to events or situations that unfold in a manner consistent with what is generally foreseen. (पूर्वानुमेय)

 
 
• **Example: **The outcome of the election was predictable, given the current political climate.
 
 
 
• **"Unexpected" **refers to something that is not anticipated or foreseen; it happens suddenly without prior indication. (अप्रत्याशित)
 
 
• **Example: **The sudden rainstorm was completely unexpected and caught everyone by surprise.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'predictable' **is **'unexpected'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Undeviating **(अविचलित): Not changing or swerving from a predetermined course.

 
 
• **Example:** The pilot maintained an undeviating course throughout the flight.
 
 
 
• **Evident **(स्पष्ट): Clearly seen or understood; obvious.
 
 
• **Example: **The benefits of the new policy were evident to everyone.
 
 
 
• **Infelicitous** (अप्रसन्न): Not suitable or appropriate; unfortunate.
 
 
• **Example:** His infelicitous remark at the meeting caused discomfort among the attendees.
